page.layout: One printed page (right side of the scan). Running head with page number at top. Above the rule, the continuation of a paragraph from the previous page. Below the rule, the question heading, its italic title, and the text beginning with a large woodcut initial. Catchword at lower right and signature at lower left. Faint show-through from the left page in the left margin is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ium: Exile, nihil, Iesu, quod pro te vatior. O non degenerem Christi obolem post tot sæcula! ô invi-diendam (aude pietas) ipsis etiam Ecclesiæ primordiis Heroinam!
main_text.head: Quæstio XXVII.

head.i: An hodie non sit periculosissi-mum, ad magnas in Republica dignitates evehi.

main_text.p: Vidi concitato nimis cer-tantem cursu, impa-ctum in metas, ad letale asthma contudisse pe-ctus: vidi violentâ ruentes in re-pagulum trabe, super ipsum præ-cipites, dirâ plagâ cruentasse vul-tum: Et Emblema vidi ingentis cujusdam ac immanis animi, quem iniqua paupertas coarctat, & ge-neris pesùm premit humilitas:

page.notes: The left margin carries only faint show-through from the facing page, not transcribed. The first word of the continuation line, "invi-diendam", is partly cut by the binding edge; the "d" at the start of the next line is uncertain. The large initial V is a woodcut, read as V of "Vidi".
